name: IAM / STS Reconnaissance
description: Before privilege escalation, attackers list who exists in the account: users, roles, groups, and the password policy. That tells them which accounts have weak passwords, which roles are over-privileged, and whether spraying passwords is worth trying. None of these calls change anything; they only read. In a quiet account they stand out because developers rarely list every user. Burst listing from a new identity is recon, not administration.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
